text:
Ava: Heads-up — our uptime SLO (99.95%) is getting noisy in us-west. We're seeing a bunch of short ~1-2m burns tied to preemptible GPU reclamations. Paging is spiking. Thoughts on windowing/suppression?

Jamal: Do you mean the user-facing alert or the internal availability metric? Which alert rule is firing? Ping me the last few firing windows.

Ava: It's the user-impact alert (alerts/slo_user_impact_availability_fired). Example: 2026-02-25 03:12 UTC, 90s downtime due to node reclaim, SLO burn showed a 0.02% blip, but our paging threshold is 0.05% over 5m so it still pages because traffic was light.

Priya: If traffic is low, raw-percentage windows are noisy. Two patterns: switch to request-weighted SLIs or increase the evaluation window to smooth transient preemptions. Also can mark planned preemptions with a label and exclude them from SLO calc.

Jamal: Quick PromQL sketch for request-weighted availability (recording rule):
```
record: app:availability:5m
expr: sum(rate(http_success_total[5m])) / sum(rate(http_requests_total[5m]))
```
Avoid `sum_over_time` division to reduce division-by-zero issues. Use `rate()` and guard with `vector(0)` if needed.

Tanvi: For alerts use a longer `for:` (15m) and Alertmanager grouping/delay (group_wait) to avoid duplicate pages. Also attach runbooks so on-call can triage faster.

Lorenzo: Another pattern we use: maintain two SLOs — `system-heartbeat` (probe-based) and `user-impact` (request-weighted). Only page on `user-impact`. Keep `system-heartbeat` as a dashboard-only signal so infra knows cluster health without waking on every preemption.

Ava: How do we exclude preemptions in Prometheus/Grafana? I can add a panel for excluded windows but want a recording-rule approach if possible.

Priya: Proposal: create two recording rules at 30m resolution:
```
record: slo:user_impact_avail:30m
expr: sum(rate(http_success_total[30m])) / sum(rate(http_requests_total[30m]))

record: slo:preemption_exclusion:30m
expr: increase(node_preemptions_total[30m]) > 0
```
Then compute effective availability by masking periods where `slo:preemption_exclusion:30m` is true (or subtract from burn calculation).

Jamal: Performance note — keep labels low-cardinality before aggregating (drop `pod` / `instance` labels with `sum(...) by (job)` or similar). Recording rules should be at 5m/30m depending on expected reaction time; 5m for metrics, 30m for SLO rollups.

Tanvi: Action items: I'll open an infra PR with the two recording rules, bump the alert `for` to 15m for user-impact, and add an Alertmanager group_wait change. Also update the runbook to prefer paging only on user-impact SLOs.

Ava: I'll run a staging exercise with kube-node-terminator to simulate preemptions and post the SLO burn graphs. If staging looks good we'll roll to prod next week. Thanks :thumbsup:

infra-bot: Created issue SRE-4820: "SLO windowing: add request-weighted SLI + preemption exclusion" (assignee: Tanvi).
